changes: Vehicle speed limits are read only from the server config; maxSpeedKilometersPerHour was removed from the vehicle resource schema and bundled templates.
Siding acceleration and service braking are limited to 0.4-1.3 m/s² (former 4 m/s² default becomes 1.0 m/s²); manual emergency braking uses 1.5 m/s² instead of 40 m/s².
Server-side train paths take the lower of the rail speed limit and sqrt(lateral acceleration x tightest horizontal radius).

Timetables brake for stops like vehicles, stopped vehicles measure delay 1 cm before their position, near-stop interpolation no longer returns -1, vehicles loaded while moving keep their speed, and vehicle limits also cap delay recovery, slower-rail braking and manual driving.
Siding vehicle, acceleration or vehicle count edits and syncs that change path speed limits regenerate the affected timetables and departures, except while paths are generating.
Client weather rendering treats vehicle cars near the camera as roofs: rain and snow stop on them, splashes land on them and the indoor rain sound plays inside.
